title: Threshold for Godot 4 is live: doors, gates and chests that open from your own tiles
html:
Threshold is live for Godot 4: 48 door, gate and chest openings, each drawn at runtime from the pixels of your own tile. It reads a tile once and rebuilds every frame of the opening from it, so a door swings in your art with no sprite sheet to draw, and closed it is exactly the tile you drew.

What it does

  • ThresholdDoor2D opens one tile, or a region of an atlas, with one of 25 motions: hinged leaves, double doors, roller shutters, a portcullis on a ratchet, a lid that tips, slides or pops, and doors that burn away, shatter, melt or pour out as sand.
  • ThresholdLayer2D reads a custom data layer on your TileSet and turns every marked tile on a TileMapLayer into a door. Neighbours with the same word open as one, and a door painted on a wall tile moves only its own rectangle.
  • 7 interiors decide what the opening shows (shadow, a lit room, a furnace, treasure, deep water), and 16 effects add dust, snow, coins, rays, mist or a mimic's teeth.
  • An open door can throw a real light across the street under your CanvasModulate night.

Tested

  • Every preset photographed under Forward+ and Compatibility: 96 frames, zero engine errors, all 48 distinct.
  • The shipped zip installed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project under both renderers: every preset, the closed picture compared texel for texel, an atlas region, signals, collision, lights, a tile taken off a TileMapLayer and put back, and a whole layer of marked tiles.
  • 9 attacks, including a path with spaces and non Latin characters, fifty doors moving at once, a third renderer, bad inputs and a renamed addon folder; 233 Readme claims checked against the shipped files.
  • Looking at the pictures found what no counter could. Every chest read as a gold dome on a box because the lid was the wrong rows of the tile and its underside vanished into the dark, a lit door sat in a hard brown box, and a lid shoved back flew off the top of the screen. The gate passed every one of them. All were fixed before release.

Free lite

The page carries a free MIT lite: 12 of the 48 presets, the same door and layer nodes, and the demo.

Where this line stands: 21 Godot packs live from this studio, 1 purchase so far (read from the store the day this went live).

Disclosure: the scripts, styles and demo were written with AI; the demo tiles come from our own generated tilesets and the cover illustration was made by an AI image model.
